feeds.title: Education Matters
feeds.description: Education Matters was first established in 1987 as a newsprint publication. Its purpose was to provide an independent non-partisan platform for teachers, parents and all those interested in education. Education Matters quickly established itself as a quality publication, covering breaking news and providing an in-depth analysis of the big issues in education.

feeds.title: Teachers' Union of Ireland
feeds.description: Teachers' Union of Ireland is a progressive, professional teachers' union, representing teachers and lecturers in vocational schools, community colleges, community & comprehensive schools, institutes of technology, further education, and other specialist areas. It is a unified and democratic body but one with a very diverse membership. Catch up with the latest news about teachers, unions, and the education system.
